description: Simulate a collective-bargaining session from either chair — the package-versus-item trap, the caucus break used as a weapon, the mandate check, the costing challenge, the last-minute add — run against your actual negotiation, with a debrief on every concession that left the table unpaid-for. Use when asked to prepare for union negotiations, rehearse a bargaining session, practice negotiating with management, or we are heading into pay talks. Symmetric: plays either side.
